pool.note: Keyed by secret bucket; the magical bucket is deleted from the roll when worldLaw.magicFunctions() is false (factionLeaderSecret.js:76), so it guarantees magic. Every line is also filtered by worldLaw.allowsSecret (magic-claim text incl. 'divine visions'), so religious#2.secret is declared magic to mirror that gate. The religious bucket is open to every faction leader (weight only), so lines that make the speaker a churchman with a role/flock/order/colleague declare institution: temple (the nearest atom; 'the speaker holds a clerical role' has no reader). military#3.secret 'selling patrol routes' presumes some patrolling force (watch|militia|garrison) — a disjunction the needs list cannot express, left undeclared. criminal#5 presumes local merchants (no atom). CENSUS-4g (R-AX, the chair's ruling of 08:3x): the clerical and soldierly rows are KEYED BY THE HOLDER'S ROLE CLASS (`holder`, read by `classOfRole`, the fact's own reader: src/data/npcData.js :: NPC_CRIMINAL_SECRETS_BY_HOLDER), not declared: the six `institution: temple` declarations are withdrawn (a temple on the roster is not a cleric holding the secret; they refused true lines and admitted false ones). religious#5 (the relic it fell to them to destroy) and military#0 (an order given in battle) are keyed by R-AD's rule (where the reading cannot decide, it declares); military#3 (patrol routes to sell) is keyed military (the holder's access), which also retires the disjunction the note above left undeclared. The key is carried: the draw reads the flat view until the mechanism lane keys it.

rows.text: Has been embezzling from the organisation they oversee for three years
Exposure means disgrace, legal prosecution, and enemies who feel personally betrayed
Secretly directs a fencing operation through a trusted intermediary
Criminal liability and the end of any political or social standing
Ordered what was officially ruled an accident, and sleeps fine about it
Murder charge, loss of everything, and the victim's family who suspects the truth
On the payroll of the thieves' guild as a silent informant
Exposure would cost them their post and likely their safety
Has been systematically bribing multiple officials for preferential treatment
A cascade of confessions from any single one of the bribed parties
Runs a protection scheme targeting the very merchants they're supposed to serve
Civil and criminal liability; the merchants have been keeping records
Has been falsifying inspection records for a fee
The next disaster caused by the uninspected goods will be traced back to them
Their legitimate business is a front for moving contraband
Seizure of everything; the legitimacy is thin and investigators are circling
Has a second family elsewhere that neither family knows about
Both relationships collapse, along with any claim to moral authority
Their identity is fabricated. They fled a different life entirely
The person they became would be destroyed; the person they were might be wanted
Suffering from an illness they expect to kill them within two years
Rivals would move against them immediately if they knew; dependents would panic
Deeply in debt to a creditor who owns the debt as leverage, not income
The creditor will call it in at the worst possible moment, and has leverage to do so
Was directly responsible for a death that was ruled an accident
Criminal liability and the complete destruction of their reputation
Has been funding a forbidden relationship with embezzled money
Both the relationship and the embezzlement would become public simultaneously
Their celebrated achievement was stolen. They took credit for another's work
The real author has evidence; they've been sitting on it for years
Has been slowly poisoning a rival with something that looks like natural illness
A competent healer or investigator would find the evidence almost immediately
Has been feeding strategic intelligence to outsiders who pay for it
Treason charges; execution or exile in most jurisdictions
Their appointment was secured through forged credentials
Discovery ends their career and discredits every decision they've made
Knows the settlement's most important legal document was fraudulently created
Revealing it destabilises everything; not revealing it makes them complicit
Has been delaying vital information from reaching the decision-makers
When the consequences emerge, the delay will be investigated and traced
Is the illegitimate heir to a title currently held by someone who doesn't know they exist
Could claim it, or could be seen as a threat by those who benefit from the status quo
Has agreed to hand over authority to an external power in exchange for personal safety
Treason. Those they've sold out would not be forgiving
Possesses a magical ability they've hidden for their entire career
In some jurisdictions, concealment is itself a crime; in all of them, it changes everything
Made a binding pact with an entity they now cannot name without consequence
The pact will come due (soon), and the terms are worse than they appeared at signing
Has been using magic to alter memories of specific events
The alterations are imperfect; some victims already sense something is wrong
Knows the location of a sealed magical site that others have been searching for
Everyone who wants it would kill for the information; none of them should have it
Is under a compulsion placed by someone who is now dead, and it's getting harder to resist
The compulsion will eventually force an action that exposes everything
Has been studying a forbidden school of magic under a false research pretext
The research has progressed to the point where hiding it grows harder each week
Lost their faith completely but maintains the role. It's just a job now
Discovery destroys their flock's trust and their own standing; some would call it heresy
Has been covering for a colleague's heretical activities out of personal loyalty
When the colleague is exposed (and they will be), this secret comes with them
Secretly receives what they believe are genuine divine visions, which terrifies them
Acting on the visions would be seen as madness; ignoring them may be worse
Has been systematically falsifying miracle reports for decades
A sceptical investigator with the right access could unravel it all in a week
Knows their religious order was founded on a historical lie
The truth would shatter the institution they've dedicated their life to
Possesses a relic that was officially declared destroyed, and kept it because they couldn't face destroying something real
Possession is heresy; surrender means explaining how they had it
Has been sending money to a disowned family member in secret for years
The family member knows enough to burn them; the payments are leverage
Knows their celebrated family history is fabricated, and helped fabricate it
The real history is much worse; discovery would shame all who share the name
One of their children is not theirs biologically, and they know it
Every inheritance, every decision, made differently if this becomes known
Owes a life-debt to someone whose interests directly conflict with their current role
The debt will eventually be called in at the worst possible moment
Has been protecting a sibling's crime for years (a serious one)
Discovery makes them an accessory; the sibling has reason to pre-empt exposure
Was present at (and did nothing to prevent) an atrocity that is now history
Complicity charges; the moral weight has been crushing them for years
Knows the actual truth behind a founding event that the settlement reveres
The truth would delegitimise current power structures; powerful people prefer the myth
Survived something everyone believes killed them, under a different name
The original identity, if revealed, carries baggage that would end the current one
Has been maintaining a cover-up of a past institutional failure that cost lives
Exposure means accountability for something that happened a long time ago, to real people
Was the informant whose report triggered a purge that destroyed innocent lives
The report was accurate in some ways but deliberately misleading in others
Possesses an original copy of a document that was officially declared destroyed
The document changes the legitimacy of something very important to very powerful people
The person who raised them was not their parent, and that parent is someone significant
The revelation would disrupt inheritance, property, and several people's sense of identity
Gave an order during a battle that caused friendly casualties. It was covered up as enemy action
The families of the dead believe a lie that this person actively maintains
Was captured and released under terms they have never disclosed
The terms may mean they owe something to an enemy that they haven't paid yet
Knows that the decisive victory everyone celebrates was won through treachery, not skill
Several people built careers on that victory; they would not appreciate the truth
Has been selling patrol routes and schedules to someone outside the settlement
People have already died as a result; they are rationalising this as survivable
Has been skimming from military supply budgets for years through a trusted subordinate
The subordinate now knows enough to destroy them, and is becoming expensive
Was ordered to commit an atrocity and complied, and has since risen in the organisation that ordered it
The order came from someone senior; exposure implicates both of them
Has been quietly shorting investments they publicly recommend, profiting from collapse
Civil fraud liability and the permanent destruction of a reputation built over decades
The goods they sell as locally produced are sourced from somewhere with exploitative labour practices
The premium they charge depends entirely on the lie holding
Has been paying a health official to suppress a finding about their product
People are being harmed; the official is growing nervous; the finding is documented
Has information about a competitor that would ruin them, obtained through clearly illegal means
Using the information exposes how it was obtained; not using it means watching an advantage expire
Their business partner died of natural causes that weren't entirely natural
An investigation would find ambiguous evidence: enough to ruin, maybe enough to prosecute
Is a member of a group that faces serious persecution, and passes for something else entirely
Discovery ends everything they have built; some of the people closest to them would turn on them
Their celebrated origin story is a fabrication they created to escape an intolerable past
The real past includes people who are still alive and who remember
Has been corresponding with someone they are publicly required to treat as an enemy
The correspondence is genuine and affectionate; it would be read as treason
Lives a second life under a different name in another part of the settlement or a nearby town
The two lives have begun to approach each other geographically
Is not who their documents say they are. The real person died years ago and they took the identity
The real person's family recently moved to the area
